newsitem.title: USA: American Brands to redeem Eurodebentures.
newsitem.headline: American Brands to redeem Eurodebentures.

text.p: American Brands Inc said Tuesday it will redeem three series of convertible Eurodollar debentures on December 12 with an aggregate principal amount currently outstanding of less than $20 million.
It said less than 600,000 shares are issuable upon conversion, adding the costs related to the redemption of these debentures will be immaterial.

The company said it will redeem its outstanding 7-3/4 percent Eurodollar Convertible Debentures Due 2002 at a redemption price of 100.775 percent of the principal amount plus accrued interest. The holders can convert their debentures into American Brands common at a price of $28.35 per share.

The company said it will redeem its outstanding 5-3/8 percent Eurodollar Convertible Debentures Due 2003 at 100 percent of the principal amount plus accrued interest. The debentures are convertible at $29.00 per share.

American Brands said it will redeem its outstanding 5-3/4 percent Eurodollar Convertible Debentures Due 2005 at a 100 percent of the principal amount plus accrued interest. The debentures are convertible at $39.50 per share.
